section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3) and its Brazilian Portuguese translation, noting it is a 30-item, 4-factor measure with items rated 1–5 and subscale scores computed as means; Cronbach's alpha was > .84 for all subscales. It mentions prior validation in university women (Swami et al., 2011) and that the newer SATAQ-4 has not been validated for Brazilian Portuguese. No study/sample-level details (e.g., sample size, country of current sample, BMI, correlations) are reported here.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Participants completed the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3; Thompson, van den Berg, Roehrig, Guarda, & Heinberg, 2004; Brazilian Portuguese translation: Swami et al., 2011), a 30-item measure... All items of the SATAQ-3 were rated on a 5-point scale (1 = totally disagree, 5 = totally agree), and subscale scores were computed as the mean of relevant items. Cronbach alpha was > .84 for all subscales."
